detours.why: the whole NFC_RFO2 transmit arm, relaid between U9.15 and L6.1 so NFC_VDD_RF can reach U9.14

note: D-620: NFC_RFO2 is the irreducible blocker of NFC_VDD_RF, NFC_RFI1 and NFC_RFI2 (screen_corridor_detour.py, five verdicts).  Its 3-track minimal cut is NOT_A_CHAIN, but its SEVEN tracks are one simple chain from U9.15 to L6.1, so the whole arm is offered to the relay as one detour.  The maze relay returns NO_PATH at 0.100, 0.050 and 0.025 mm because U9.15's escape margin is EXACTLY ZERO and a lattice adds a 0.75-cell guard band, so the record names the allowlisted exact-geometry route that laid this arm in the first place.
